name: CanvasTTY Assistant
description: The Assistant: reviews agents' shell commands and file writes before they run, and helps orchestrators: a route tool that suggests provider and model for a subagent, flows (roles and tasks an orchestrator asks you to approve), a task board, loop alerts on cards a session report, and Model: Auto (Jev) for OpenCode (a local, key-protected router on 127.0.0.1 that picks an allowed model per turn). Decision models (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama) are optional. Settings → Plugins → CanvasTTY Assistant → Settings.
description.ru: Помощник: проверяет команды и записи файлов агентов до запуска и помогает оркестраторам: инструмент route предлагает провайдера и модель для субагента, сценарии (роли и задачи, которые оркестратор просит одобрить), доска задач, сигнал «цикл?» на окне отчёт о сессии и модель «Авто (Jev)» для OpenCode (локальный маршрутизатор на 127.0.0.1 с ключом, выбирает разрешённую модель на каждый ход). Модели решений (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama) не обязательны. Настройки → Плагины → Ассистент CanvasTTY → Настройки.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Assistant
services.description: Command review, launch triage, routing, flows, task boards, loop alerts, session reports and the Auto (Jev) model router (127.0.0.1 only, while Auto is used).

fields.label: Model: Auto picks one per turn (OpenCode; keep Model at Default, no account)
fields.label.ru: Модель: Авто выбирает на каждый ход (OpenCode; без аккаунта и своей модели)

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Ask the Assistant how to run a task before you spawn a subagent for it: its kind and difficulty, whether it needs a worktree or a container, whether command review will be strict, whether it splits into parallel subagents, and whether the task misses information. Advice only: nothing is started.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

tools.name: review_status
tools.description: How the Assistant's command review runs now (mode, strictness, decision models) and its last decisions on your card and your subagents: what was allowed, declined or sent to the person, and why.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Before spawn_agent: suggests provider, model and effort for a subagent's task (a small model for routine work, the strongest offered for hard work). Pass list_providers().providers as `providers` so it picks from what is available. Pass the answer's spawn values to spawn_agent; nothing is started here. Uses a decision model when one is set up, else simple rules.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

providers.description: Optional: the providers array from list_providers, so the suggestion uses what is installed, signed in and its known models.

prefer.description: Optional provider id to prefer when it is available.

launchOptionTools.description: Optional: list_providers().launchOptionTools, to name the account tool to call.

tools.name: flows_list
tools.description: Lists flows: named sets of roles (for example executor and reviewer), built in and from this project's .canvastty/flows folder. Use flow_plan to propose one.

tools.name: flow_plan
tools.description: Asks the person to approve a flow for a goal. Returns only the plan id and the role names: the person sees roles, provider/model and tasks in the Flow preview card and presses Start or Cancel. Do not start subagents for it before flow_status says approved; it then gives the spawn values.

providers.description: Optional: the providers array from list_providers, so the suggestion uses what is installed, signed in and its known models.

tools.name: flow_status
tools.description: Whether the person started or cancelled your flow plan (waits up to 10 s). When approved, it lists exactly what to pass to spawn_agent for each role.

planId.description: The plan id from flow_plan; omit for your newest plan (also one the person chose for you).

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the person, 0 to 10 seconds (default 10).

tools.name: task_add
tools.description: Adds a task to your task board (the person sees it in the Task board card). Optionally give it to one of your subagents by session id.

assignee.description: Optional session id of one of your subagents.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Updates a task on the board: status todo, doing, done or blocked, and a short note. A subagent may update a task given to it, or claim an unassigned one.

id.description: The task id, for example t3.

note.description: A short note (what changed, what blocks it).

assignee.description: Orchestrator only: a subagent session id, or empty to clear.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: The task board of your orchestrator (or your own, for an orchestrator): ids, titles, status, assignee and notes.

contributions.title: Assistant
contributions.description: Command review, automatic routing, loop alerts and flows.

contributions.title: Decision models
contributions.description: Optional decision models (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama), data rules, recent reviews and Auto (Jev) model routing.

contributions.title: Flow preview
contributions.description: Roles and tasks of a proposed flow, for you to approve or cancel.

contributions.title: Task board
contributions.description: Tasks of an orchestrator and its subagents.
